DURING AIRCRAFT REFUELING WHEN THE NOZZLE IS INSERTED INTO THE FUEL FILLER, IT OPENS THE ANTI-SYPHON VALVE FLAPPER DOOR (SPRING LOADED) AND EXTENDS INTO THE TANK AREA.  THE AREA OF ANTI-SYPHON VALVE THAT THE FLAPPER DOOR SEALS AGAINST IS CALLED THE PAN. THIS PART OF THE ANTI-SYPHON VALVE GETS DAMAGED (BENT) FROM THE NOZZLE.  AFTER THE PAN IS DAMAGED, THE FLAPPER DOOR CANNOT SEAL AND THE ANTI-SYPHON VALVE BECOMES LESS EFFECTIVE.  SUBMITTER RECOMMENDS CARE BE TAKEN WHEN INSERTING THE NOZZLE INTO THE TANK AND FUELING.

AFTER TAKEOFF, WHEN THE FLIGHT CREW RETRACTED THE LANDING GEAR, THE CONTROL HANDLE WOULD NOT POSITION TO THE UP POSITION.  THE CREW RETURNED THE GEAR HANDLE TO THE DOWN POSITION, RECEIVING THREE DOWN AND LOCK INDICATIONS.  A SECOND ATTEMPT TO RETRACT THE GEAR WAS UNSUCCESSFUL AND THE AIRCRAFT RETURNED TO DFW.  MAINTENANCE INSPECTED THE AIRCRAFT, FINDING THE LANDING GEAR ANTI-RETRACT LATCH MECHANISM MISRIGGED.  MAINTENANCE RIGGED THE SYSTEM IN ACCORDANCE WITH THE DOUGLAS MAINTENANCE MANUAL AND THE AIRCRAFT WAS RETURNED TO SERVICE.

THE LINE IS LOCATED BEHIND THE INSTRUMENT PANEL AND SIDE PANEL IN A VERY HARD TO SEE AREA.  IT WAS FOUND CORRODED AND DEEPLY PITTED AND LEAKING HYDRAULIC FLUID DURING AN AVIONICS INSTALLATION.  THE CAUSE OF THE CORROSION WAS DETERMINED TO BE A DEFROSTER DUCT DIRECTLY ABOVE THE LINE AND TOUCHING IT.  THE DEFROSTER DUCT WAS THE OLD STYLE SCAT TYPE DUCTING THAT WAS MADE OF COTTON MATERIAL AND IRON FORMING WIRE.  OVER THE YEARS, THE COTTON DETERIORATED AND THE IRON WIRE RUSTED FROM MOISTURE AND BEGAN TO POKE THROUGH THE COTTON ALLOWING THE RUSTED WIRE TO CONTACT THE ALUMINUM LINE CAUSING A DISSIMILAR METAL SITUATION AND CORROSION.

THE ALUMINUMN LINE REFERENCED ABOVE WAS AN OIL PRESSURE LINE FOR THE OIL PRESSURE GAUGE.  IT IS LOCATED BEHIND THE INSTRUMENT PANEL IN A VERY HARD TO SEE AREA.  IT WAS FOUND CORRODED AND DEEPLY PITTED AND LEAKING OIL DURING AN AVIONICS INSTALLATION.  THE CAUSE OF THE CORROSION WAS DETERMINED TO BE A DEFROSTER DUCT DIRECTLY ABOVE THE LINE AND TOUCHING IT.  THE DEFROSTER DUCT WAS THE OLD STYLE SCAT TYPE DUCTING THAT WAS MADE OF COTTON MATERIAL AND IRON FORMING WIRE.  OVER THE YEARS THE COTTON DETERIORATED AND THE IRON WIRE RUSTED FROM MOISTURE AND BEGAN TO POKE THROUGH THE COTTON ALLOWING THE RUSTED WIRE TO CONTACT THE ALUMINUM LINE CAUSING A DISSIMILAR METAL SITUATION AND CORROSION.

THE ALUMINUM LINE WAS A BRAKE LINE FOR THE RT BRAKE.  IT IS LOCATED BEHIND INSTRUMENT PANEL AND SIDE PANEL IN A VERY HARD TO SEE AREA.  IT WAS FOUND CORRODED AND DEEPLY PITTED AND LEAKING HYD FLUID DURING AVIONIC INSTALL.  SUBMITTER STATED CAUSE OF CORROSION WAS DETERMINED TO BE A DEFROSTER DUCT DIRECTLY ABOVE THE LINE AND TOUCHING IT.  THE DEFROSTER DUCT WAS THE OLD STYLE SCAT TYPE DUCTING THAT WAS MADE OF COTTON MATERIAL AND IRON FORMING WIRE.  OVER THE YEARS, THE COTTON DETERIORATED AND THE IRON WIRE RUSTED FROM MOISTURE AND BEGAN TO POKE THROUGH THE COTTON ALLOWING THE RUSTED WIRE TO CONTACT THE ALUM LINE CAUSING A DISSIMILAR METAL SITUATION AND CORROSION.

THE ALUMINUM LINE WAS AN OIL PRESSURE LINE RUNNING FROM THE FIREWALL TO THE OIL PRESS GAUGE.  IT IS LOCATED BEHIND THE INSTRUMENT PANEL IN A VERY HARD TO SEE AREA.  IT WAS FOUND CORRODED AND DEEPLY PITTED.  DISCOVERED DURING AN ANNUAL INSPECTION.  THE CAUSE OF THE CORROSION WAS DETERMINED TO BE A DEFROSTER DUCT DIRECTLY ABOVE THE LINE AND TOUCHING IT.  THE DEFROSTER DUCT WAS THE OLD STYLE SCAT TYPE DUCTING MADE OF COTTON MATERIAL AND IRON FORMING WIRE.  OVER THE YEARS, COTTON DETERIORATED AND IRON WIRE RUSTED FROM MOISTURE AND BEGAN TO POKE THROUGH THE COTTON ALLOWING THE RUSTED WIRE TO CONTACT THE ALUM LINE CAUSING A DISSIMILAR METAL SITUATION AND CORROSION.

AIRCRAFT HAD NORMAL LANDING UNTIL NOSE GEAR TOUCHED DOWN.  THE AIRCRAFT HAD BEEN TRACKING STRAIGHT DOWN THE RUNWAY UNTIL THE NOSE WHEEL TOUCHED DOWN WHEN THE ACFT BEGAN DRIFTING TO THE RIGHT. OIL PRESSURE GAUGE LINE FAILED DURING TAKEOFF ROLL.  OBSERVERS ON GROUND SPOTTED A SMOKE TRAIL AND CONTACTED PILOT BY RADIO.  FLT RETURNED AND LANDED WITHOUT INCIDENT.  PILOT REPORTED  OIL PRESS GAUGE STILL SHOWED IN THE GREEN DESPITE LINE FAILURE AND THERE WAS NO SMOKE IN THE CABIN OR OTHER INDICATION OF FAILURE.
